messages:
maria: kicking off alpha split for model 'redwood-chat-v2-int8' at 1% tonight 22:00 UTC. want to lock down gates before we push.

chen: quick note: ran our eval suite against ~6k prompts (qa + longform). results: mean embed-sim delta = -0.9% vs baseline, hallucination rate +0.7% (p=0.12), latency improved ~35ms median.

ryan: do we have per-segment breakdowns (short vs long)?

chen: short: embed-sim -0.3%, long: -1.6% (regressions concentrated on multi-hop reasoning prompts). hallucination delta concentrated in "knowledge recall" subset.

maria: proposal: alpha schedule 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% with gating at each step. gates = (embed_sim_delta > -1.5%) AND (hallucination_delta < +1.0%) AND (p_value < 0.1 for regression) AND (latency_improvement >= 10ms).

sylvia: p_value < 0.1 seems loose for safety-critical failures, can we add hysteresis (e.g., require 2 consecutive windows passing) and a min sample floor?

maria: yes — plan is 2-window hysteresis + min requests per window + variance floor.

chen: draft gating config below. this is what will be read by the rollout orchestrator and the dashboard alerts.

```yaml
alpha_split:
  steps: [1, 5, 20, 50]
  step_duration: 4h
  windows: 2 # consecutive windows required to move to next step
  metrics:
    embed_sim_delta_threshold: -0.015  # -1.5%
    hallucination_delta_threshold: 0.01 # +1.0%
    latency_improvement_min_ms: 10
    min_requests_per_window: 500
    stat_sig_p: 0.1
  rollback_on_fail: true
  rollback_to: stable
  max_drift_pct_per_step: 0.5
```

ryan: how do we compute embed_sim? mean cosine over the eval set? moving average?

chen: mean cosine on QA/summary eval splits with per-example bootstrap CIs; we report both point delta and bootstrapped 95% CI. rolling mean per-window (4h) used for gating.

maria: deployment plan: start tonight 22:00 UTC targeting eu-west1 small cohort. monitoring dashboard posts to #eng-oncall and deploy-bot will auto-rollback if a hard trigger is hit.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: redwood-chat-v2-int8 -> 1% in eu-west1 at 2026-03-20T22:00Z

sylvia: do we want an automatic freeze if metric variance exceeds X? noisy metrics create false positives/negatives.

maria: add variance guard: if std(embed_sim) across per-bucket > 0.04 hold the rollout and escalate to human review.

chen: ran a traffic sim with our mix; expected ~1200 requests/window when moving 1%->5%, so should meet min_requests_per_window.

ryan: quick sanity check: if hallucination uptick is +0.9% but p=0.09 do we proceed? that feels borderline.

maria: decision: require metrics AND stat_sig to pass. borderline passes (within 0.1 thresholds) will be flagged for manual review in #eng-ml before progressing to 20%.

sylvia: please add to runbook the manual intervention path and signoff requirements (PM + ML lead).

maria: will add. saving gating config to infra repo and tagging the rollout:

```bash
# infra/rollouts/alpha/redwood-chat-v2-int8.yaml
git add infra/rollouts/alpha/redwood-chat-v2-int8.yaml
git commit -m "alpha split gating: embed/hallucination/latency checks"
git push origin main
```

chen: post-rollout eval snapshots will be uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/alpha-v2-int8/{timestamp}.json and pushed to the dashboard.

maria: thanks team. sync tomorrow 09:30 PT if any manual steps triggered. :thumbsup:

ryan: thanks

sylvia: 👍
